/* QSF-driven field definitions and validation, shared by the website and Apps Script. */
(function(root) {
  'use strict';
  const source=root.LEAPQ_SOURCE;
  const fields=[];
  const choiceOrder=q=>(q.ChoiceOrder||[]).map(String);
  const key=(qid,choice,slot)=> (slot?'L'+slot+'_':'')+qid+(choice?'_'+choice:'');
  const languages=a=>choiceOrder(source.questions.QID4).map(slot=>({slot,name:String(a[key('QID4',slot)]||'').trim()})).filter(l=>l.name);
  function define(qid,slot) {
    const q=source.questions[qid],ids=choiceOrder(q);
    const add=(k,type,choice)=>fields.push({key:k,type,qid,slot:slot||null,choice:choice||null,label:q.QuestionText+(choice?' — '+q.Choices[choice].Display:'')});
    if(q.QuestionType==='DB')return;
    if(q.QuestionType==='TE'){
      if(q.Selector==='FORM')ids.forEach(id=>add(key(qid,id,slot),'text',id));
      else add(key(qid,null,slot),qid==='QID10'?'number':'text');
    }else if(q.QuestionType==='MC'){
      if(q.Selector==='MAVR')ids.forEach(id=>add(key(qid,id,slot),'checkbox',id));
      else add(key(qid,null,slot),'choice');
      ids.filter(id=>q.Choices[id].TextEntry).forEach(id=>add(key(qid,id+'_TEXT',slot),'text',id));
    }else if(q.QuestionType==='CS'||q.QuestionType==='Slider'){
      ids.forEach(id=>add(key(qid,id,slot),q.QuestionType==='CS'?'number':'slider',id));
    }else throw new Error('Unsupported QSF question type '+q.QuestionType);
  }
  source.pages.forEach(page=>{if(page.loop){for(let slot=1;slot<=5;slot++)page.questions.forEach(qid=>define(qid,String(slot)));}else page.questions.forEach(qid=>define(qid));});
  function pages(a) {
    return source.pages.flatMap(page=>page.loop?languages(a).map(l=>({questions:page.questions,slot:l.slot,language:l.name})): [{questions:page.questions}]);
  }
  function activeFields(a) {
    const slots=languages(a).map(l=>l.slot);
    return fields.filter(f=>!f.slot||slots.includes(f.slot));
  }
  function validate(a,pageIndex) {
    const errors=[];
    const value=k=>String(a[k]===undefined?'':a[k]).trim();
    const issue=(k,message)=>errors.push({key:k,message});
    pages(a).forEach((page,index)=>{
      if(pageIndex!==undefined&&pageIndex!==index)return;
      page.questions.forEach(qid=>{
        const q=source.questions[qid],ids=choiceOrder(q),settings=(q.Validation||{}).Settings||{};
        const k=(id)=>key(qid,id,page.slot),required=settings.ForceResponse==='ON';
        if(q.QuestionType==='DB')return;
        if(q.QuestionType==='TE'){
          if(q.Selector==='FORM'){
            // The QSF's custom validation only requires row 1 in these forms.
            if(settings.Type==='CustomValidation'&&!value(k('1')))issue(k('1'),'Please enter a response in the first row.');
          }else{
            if(required&&!value(k()))issue(k(),'Please answer this question.');
            if(value(k())&&settings.ContentType==='ValidNumber'&&!Number.isFinite(Number(value(k()))))issue(k(),'Please enter a valid number.');
          }
        }else if(q.QuestionType==='MC'){
          if(q.Selector==='MAVR'){
            if(required&&!ids.some(id=>a[k(id)]===true))issue(k(ids[0]),'Please select at least one answer.');
          }else{
            const v=value(k());
            if(required&&!v)issue(k(),'Please select an answer.');
            else if(v&&!ids.includes(v))issue(k(),'Please select one of the available answers.');
          }
          // TextEntry fields have no TextEntryForceResponse in this QSF.
        }else if(q.QuestionType==='CS'){
          let total=0,invalid=false;
          ids.forEach(id=>{const v=value(k(id));if(v&&!Number.isFinite(Number(v))){issue(k(id),'Please enter a valid number.');invalid=true;}else total+=Number(v||0);});
          if(!invalid&&Math.abs(total-Number(settings.ChoiceTotal))>0.000001)issue(k(ids[0]),'The total must equal '+settings.ChoiceTotal+'% (currently '+total+'%).');
          // EnforceRange is OFF: do not invent per-row bounds or require zeros in blank rows.
        }else if(q.QuestionType==='Slider'){
          ids.forEach(id=>{const v=value(k(id)),n=Number(v);if(v&&(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<q.Configuration.CSSliderMin||n>q.Configuration.CSSliderMax||!Number.isInteger(n)))issue(k(id),'Please use the slider to select a value from 0 to 10.');});
        }
      });
    });
    activeFields(a).forEach(f=>{if((pageIndex===undefined)&&value(f.key).length>5000)issue(f.key,'Please use no more than 5,000 characters.');});
    return errors;
  }
  root.LeapQ={version:'LEAP-Q-QSF-SV_2mgBwGk76i6HIdD-v1',source,fields,key,choiceOrder,languages,pages,activeFields,validate};
})(typeof globalThis!=='undefined'?globalThis:this);
if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=globalThis.LeapQ;

/* Google Apps Script backend. See README.md for deployment instructions. */
var SPREADSHEET_ID = '121p3XrVm4ssktWA2lbexkFAHo-MPBnNENyMQOrvL78A';
// Keep the earlier Word-questionnaire responses intact in their original tab.
var RESPONSE_SHEET_NAME = 'LEAP-Q QSF';
var ALLOWED_ORIGINS = ['https://nkhaloo.github.io', 'http://localhost:8000', 'http://127.0.0.1:8000'];

function doGet() {
  return ContentService.createTextOutput('LEAP-Q receiver is running. Submit questionnaires from the survey website.');
}

function doPost(e) {
  var p = (e && e.parameter) || {};
  var result = {type:'leapq-submission', nonce:String(p.nonce || ''), submission_id:'', ok:false};
  var origin = String(p.origin || '');
  if (ALLOWED_ORIGINS.indexOf(origin) === -1) {
    return HtmlService.createHtmlOutput('This survey origin is not configured.');
  }
  try {
    if (!/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/i.test(result.nonce)) throw new Error('Invalid request nonce.');
    if (!p.payload || p.payload.length > 100000) throw new Error('Invalid or oversized submission.');
    var payload = JSON.parse(p.payload);
    result.submission_id = payload.submission_id;
    if (!/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/i.test(payload.submission_id || '')) throw new Error('Invalid submission ID.');
    if (payload.version !== LeapQ.version) throw new Error('Questionnaire version mismatch. Please contact the researcher.');
    var a = payload.answers;
    if (!a || typeof a !== 'object' || Array.isArray(a)) throw new Error('Missing questionnaire answers.');
    // Only accept defined fields and primitive values. Never store caller-supplied columns.
    var clean = {};
    LeapQ.fields.forEach(function(f) {
      var v = a[f.key];
      if (v === undefined) v = f.type === 'checkbox' ? false : '';
      if (f.type === 'checkbox') {
        if (typeof v !== 'boolean') throw new Error('Invalid checkbox response.');
      } else if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.length > 5000) {
        throw new Error('Invalid response for ' + f.label + '.');
      }
      clean[f.key] = typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim() : v;
    });
    var errors = LeapQ.validate(clean);
    if (errors.length) throw new Error(errors[0].message);
    // Only filled dominance slots are looped in the QSF; preserve their original slot IDs.
    var active = LeapQ.activeFields(clean).map(function(f) { return f.key; });
    LeapQ.fields.forEach(function(f) {
      if (active.indexOf(f.key) === -1) clean[f.key] = f.type === 'checkbox' ? false : '';
    });
    saveResponse_(payload.submission_id, clean);
    result.ok = true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    result.error = /^(Please |The total |Invalid |Missing |Questionnaire version)/.test(error.message)
      ? error.message : 'The response could not be saved. Please contact the researcher or try again.';
  }
  // HtmlService runs inside an Apps Script sandbox iframe. top is the GitHub Pages
  // window; an explicit target origin and unpredictable nonce bind the acknowledgement.
  var json = JSON.stringify(result).replace(/</g, '\\u003c').replace(/\u2028/g, '\\u2028').replace(/\u2029/g, '\\u2029');
  var target = JSON.stringify(origin);
  return HtmlService.createHtmlOutput('<!doctype html><html><body><script>window.top.postMessage(' + json + ',' + target + ');</script></body></html>')
    .setXFrameOptionsMode(HtmlService.XFrameOptionsMode.ALLOWALL);
}

function saveResponse_(id, a) {
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    var book = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
    var sheet = book.getSheetByName(RESPONSE_SHEET_NAME) || book.insertSheet(RESPONSE_SHEET_NAME);
    var headers = ['received_at_utc', 'submission_id', 'questionnaire_version'].concat(LeapQ.fields.map(function(f) { return f.key; }));
    if (sheet.getMaxColumns() < headers.length) sheet.insertColumnsAfter(sheet.getMaxColumns(), headers.length - sheet.getMaxColumns());
    if (sheet.getLastRow() === 0) {
      sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
      sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    } else {
      var existing = sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).getValues()[0];
      if (existing.some(function(v, j) { return v !== headers[j]; })) throw new Error('The QSF response tab has incompatible headers. Please contact the researcher.');
    }
    // Deduplicate a retry after an acknowledgement timeout, under the same lock.
    if (sheet.getLastRow() > 1) {
      var found = sheet.getRange(2, 2, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, 1).createTextFinder(id).matchEntireCell(true).findNext();
      if (found) return;
    }
    var row = [new Date().toISOString(), id, LeapQ.version].concat(LeapQ.fields.map(function(f) {
      var value = a[f.key];
      if (f.type === 'checkbox') return value ? 'Yes' : 'No';
      if (value === undefined || value === '') return '';
      if (['number', 'slider'].indexOf(f.type) !== -1) return Number(value);
      // Prevent spreadsheet formula injection in free-text cells.
      return /^[=+\-@\t\r\n]/.test(value) ? "'" + value : value;
    }));
    sheet.getRange(sheet.getLastRow() + 1, 1, 1, row.length).setValues([row]);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}
